messages:
Sam: Async check-in — Yesterday: shipped gateway route-rewrite to staging; adjusted rate policy for a set of beta tenants. Blockers: seeing 429 spikes in the canary path (6–12s window) when bursts hit auth checks, need request traces. Today: dig into 429s + KV cache hit patterns, follow up on auth token rotation, review @Maya's PR.

Maya: PR #2324 is up for the route-rewrite -> dedicated tests failing on jwt rotation. Repro steps are in the PR. pinging @Ravi for infra bits. :eyes: 

Ravi: I'll take the review after standup. I reran CI and hit the same flaky test in jwt-rotation::token-refresh. Likely a timing flake with the mock KMS. I'll add a small retry and re-run.

Priya: oncall note — observed the 429 burst at ~09:17 UTC, added extra ingress logs and tagged traces trace-abc123 trace-def456. Temporarily lowered burst_size 50 -> 30 in the canary ratepolicy to reduce tail errors; watching effects.

Sam: can you paste the trace IDs and a minimal curl to repro? will try to replay locally.

Priya: trace ids: abc123, def456. Repro curl (staging):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" "https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -d '"{\"prompt\":\"test\"}"
```
Also the 429s seem correlated with a 2–6s auth token rotation window.

Ravi: thanks — I'll replay with those trace ids and instrument the mock KMS timings. If it's KMS jitter I'll introduce a jittered backoff in the client and bump the test timeout.

Maya: note added in PR for fallback to legacy auth flow if rotation fails > 5s. Will also include a short integration test for rotation edge case. :+1: 

deploy-bot: Deployed gateway v1.4.2 to staging at 2025-10-02T09:12:33Z — rollout OK.

Sam: plan: Ravi to patch test/retry, Priya to keep monitoring and drop any new trace ids, Maya to land fallback + integration test. Check-in update by 11:00 UTC. Thanks :thumbsup:
